propositions: Identical allowlisted read-only tool calls (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) waste budget by re-executing and re-paying round-trips; memoization at the agent-call seam must return cached results on first duplicate without re-invoking the tool.

Error-prefixed result strings indicate transient/retry-able conditions and must not be memoized; deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)' are honest stable answers and must be memoized to eliminate pathological loops (62x observed case).

Nudge escalation steers the model away from repeated queries: first duplicate carries a level-1 static templated nudge, subsequent repeats carry a level-2 escalated nudge; both are byte-stable for provider prompt caching and do not require manifest/in-context awareness.

The existing runaway-guard actuator (distinct-ratio window) must remain the abort backstop and continue observing all memoized duplicates at the same window semantics; wrapper order is guard→memo→steering so the guard's call_tool observes signatures before memo short-circuits.
Non-allowlisted and write tools (e.g. record_criterion_verdict) must always execute without memoization; only the four read-only allowlisted tools are memoized.
Concurrent batches within a single agentic turn must be serialized per signature using asyncio.Lock to prevent cache races while identical duplicate calls in the same turn are served from cache.
